explanation: The only close Mathlib declaration is `OpenPartialHomeomorph.MDifferentiable.mfderiv_bijective` (Mathlib/Geometry/Manifold/MFDeriv/Atlas.lean). It is stated for an `OpenPartialHomeomorph` that is `MDifferentiable`, not for a `PartialDiffeomorph`. The theorem's proof already uses it. It first has to build the `MDifferentiable` hypothesis from `Φ.mdifferentiableOn` and `Φ.symm.mdifferentiableOn`, which is an auxiliary fact proved along the way. `PartialDiffeomorph` appears only in Mathlib/Geometry/Manifold/LocalDiffeomorph.lean. That file has no mfderiv or bijectivity lemma for it. Its mfderiv lemmas (`IsLocalDiffeomorphAt.isInvertible_mfderiv`, `Diffeomorph.isInvertible_mfderiv`) cover local diffeomorphisms and diffeomorphisms, and there is no `PartialDiffeomorph` to `IsLocalDiffeomorphAt` bridge. So I found no single declaration that gives this result with a one- or two-line derivation.
